top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia, UAE Push Ahead With Data Center Plans
top_signals.summary: The Persian Gulf’s richest states are pushing ahead with plans for a massive build-out of artificial intelligence infrastructure despite data centers becoming targets in the US-Iran war. Bloomberg's Zainab Fattah discusses how firms are responding to perceptions of higher risk on Horizons Middle East & Africa. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Yen Tops Intervention Rally to Reach Highest Since February
